paragraphs.text: Goddric is a Dragon from Eldraine who disguised himself as a Human Noble man.

Goddric attended the Grand Ball at Delverhaugh in the guise of a handsome human man. When the human woman Ash arrived at the feast disguised as a knight, Goddric asked her to dance. After redcaps raided the party , he was forced to reveal his true form to protect Ash and the other guests. When she fled the party at midnight, he may have used her discarded helm to help identify her later.
